judged_text: Line 6's `<%- end if %>` emits the Ruby fragment `end if`, which is a syntax error (a bare `end` cannot carry a modifier `if`), so this ERB template never compiles. Every request to /embed/best for a URL that already has a topic raises ActionView::Template::Error and returns a 500 — the feature's entire 'show the best comments' output path is dead and the iframe renders an error page instead of the discussion; the new controller specs cannot catch it because rspec-rails 2.x controller specs do not compile views (no render_views).

adjudication.rationale: In `app/views/embed/best.html.erb`, the header block closes with `<%- end if %>`, which will emit the Ruby code `end if` (with no condition). A bare `end` cannot take a modifier `if`, and `if` without an expression is invalid, so this template would fail to compile/render when hit. The diff shows no other matching `if` for that trailing `if`, confirming it’s not intentional Ruby syntax.
